## Overview
- Fix #60518 with a method to avoid decoding/unpacking all frames duplicately



## Claims
**Metadata recovery time (best of 4 runs)**

| Approach | 20f WebM (4KB) | 900f 1080p WebM (1.4MB) | 20f raw H.264 (2KB) | 900f 1080p H.264 (582MB) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| demux (cv2 rawMode) | 0.10ms | 0.80ms | 0.25ms | 343ms |
| decode-count (cv2 grab) | 1.90ms | 85.5ms | 2.59ms | 3092ms |
| stdlib probe | 0.06ms | 1.45ms | 0.01ms | 154ms |
| torchcodec exact | 0.37ms | 0.90ms | n/a | n/a |
| pyav demux | 0.18ms | 1.77ms | 0.32ms | 333ms |
